name: Katsuragi Marina
source:
A talented girl and the protagonist's childhood friend. Has a sense of justice and strives to protect everyone from danger.

In [url=/v18588]Kouyoku Senki ExS-Tia 2[/url], she become the protagonist's girlfriend.
